decisions.statement: One reading answers every token that reading passes.
A masked body blanks every string and template piece and comment the source held.
A masked body keeps every newline the source held.
A masked body is as long as the source.
A template is answered as the template's literal pieces and the template's expressions.
A template inside a template expression is read as a template of its own.
A string with an escape is answered with no value.
A slash opens a pattern only where the token before the slash cannot end a value.
A call's arguments are answered as the span each argument covers.
A call whose bracket never closes is answered as nothing rather than as no arguments.
This module reads a body without a parser where the tree already has a parse.

definition: the strings, templates and call arguments a body holds, and that body with them blanked
